documentation:
A person this console administers, whose account lives on another stack.

`accountId` is the identity link to that account — for a patient, an hc-patient-gateway account, since patients register there and this stack's gateway never issues ROLE_PATIENT. Backlog item 115.

fields.documentation: The hc-patient gateway account this record belongs to — the estate join of 2026-09-17, `account.id = accountId`, the same identifier Profile.accountId carries. An id, never a login, never an email, and never hc-patient's own patientId. It is set by the patient event stream and by the api's backfill, never typed in: the edit form carries it disabled and the guard for that is account-id-is-carried-not-offered.spec.ts, which this generator does not own.

Archived records are hidden from the directory rather than deleted; the list filters `isArchived.notEquals=true`, which matches a null. Absent from this file and from hc-admin.jdl until backlog item 135, so a regeneration dropped it from patient.model.ts and the form service together — which a model-to-form parity guard cannot see, both sides losing it at once. Carried through the edit form disabled, but NOT for accountId's reason: the field may be changed freely, it simply may not have a second writer. PatientService.setArchived PATCHes it alone and argues against the whole-document PUT an enabled control would make. A regeneration would re-create it as an editable checkbox; the guard is archived-survives-an-edit.spec.ts, which this generator does not own.
